summary: Bob cautiously undergoes a religious-political evaluation by Minister Travis. Dr. Landers explains how factions within FAITH threaten artificial intelligence and the replicant program before placing Bob in a virtual exercise that simulates control of an orbital station. Bob uses GUPPI to monitor routine conditions and turns to the library to understand the world and his likely purpose.

introducing.name: Ministry of Truth
introducing.description: A FAITH ministry that finances the replicant venture and has military, colonization, and diplomatic responsibilities.

introducing.name: Ministry of Proper Thought
introducing.description: A FAITH ministry that uses direct neurological stimulation as part of re-education.

updates.description: The Free American Independent Theocratic Hegemony, a theocratic U.S. government that makes criticism a felony and permits the deactivation of machine persons for it. It restricts information by default and is split into factions, some regarding AI and replicants as abominations or rejecting all technology since steam power.

updates.name: GUPPI
updates.description: An interface that offloads tasks for replicants while retaining their human limits on multitasking. Its name expands to General Unit Primary Peripheral Interface.
